recent_posts.title: Develop a XAA-Enabled Resource Application and Test with Okta
recent_posts.summary: Cross App Access (XAA) enables enterprise resource applications to become AI-ready by delegating access management to an Identity Provider. Resource apps validate ID-JAG tokens from AI agents by verifying the IdP's signature, checking the audience claim matches their identifier, and confirming the user identity. This tutorial walks through enabling XAA in Okta, registering both a sample requesting app (Agent0) and resource app (TaskFlow), establishing trust connections between them, and testing the complete token exchange flow including ID-JAG verification and OAuth client registration.

recent_posts.title: Make Secure App-to-App Connections Using Cross App Access
recent_posts.summary: Cross App Access (XAA) is an OAuth extension that enables secure app-to-app integrations in enterprise environments by using the Identity Provider as a central broker. Unlike API keys or standard OAuth flows, XAA provides IT governance, reduces user friction, and enables granular security through a two-step token exchange process: first exchanging an ID token for an intermediary ID-JAG token from the IdP, then exchanging that for an access token from the resource app's authorization server. The tutorial demonstrates implementing XAA in a NestJS note-taking app that connects to a to-do app using the xaa.dev testing playground.

recent_posts.title: Take User Provisioning to the Next Level with Entitlements
recent_posts.summary: SCIM (System for Cross-Domain Identity Management) enables automated user provisioning and entitlements management for B2B SaaS applications. This hands-on workshop demonstrates building SCIM endpoints to support user roles and custom entitlements, implementing resource types and schemas for discovery, and integrating with Okta Identity Governance. The tutorial covers database modeling for roles, TypeScript interfaces for SCIM resources, implementing /Roles, /ResourceTypes, /Schemas, and /Characteristics endpoints, and syncing user entitlements between identity providers and applications. Developers learn to extend SCIM's core User resource with custom attributes, handle multi-tenant scenarios, and centralize access management through identity providers.

recent_posts.title: Introducing xaa.dev: A Playground for Cross App Access
recent_posts.summary: Cross App Access (XAA) solves the challenge of letting AI agents and applications securely access enterprise resources on behalf of users without consent prompts or credential exposure. Built on the emerging IETF Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant specification, XAA shifts access control from end users to the enterprise identity layer using cryptographically signed ID-JAG tokens. The new xaa.dev playground provides a free, zero-setup testing environment where developers can explore the complete XAA flow across all components: requesting apps, resource apps, identity providers, and MCP servers. The playground eliminates the complexity of local infrastructure setup, allowing developers to understand token exchanges, inspect protocol flows, and test their own applications against working XAA implementations in under 60 seconds.

recent_posts.title: Okta Developer Connect Recap
recent_posts.summary: Okta hosted its first Developer Connect event in Bengaluru, India, bringing together developers and IAM practitioners to discuss how identity sits at the intersection of application architecture, security, and AI-driven systems. The event covered identity fundamentals, modern use cases including AI agents, Cross App Access, Okta Workflows, and Verifiable Digital Credentials. Sessions emphasized identity as foundational infrastructure that determines how safely distributed systems interact and scale. The event featured interactive discussions, Q&A sessions, and direct engagement with Okta engineers, marking the start of an ongoing series focused on practical identity education.

recent_posts.title: Customize Okta sign-in pages with Tailwind and Alpine.js
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to customize Okta's hosted sign-in page beyond basic branding by implementing Tailwind CSS for responsive layouts, adding custom HTML elements like footers, and creating interactive components using Alpine.js. The tutorial demonstrates using Web APIs like MutationObserver to control modal behavior, implementing terms and conditions acceptance flows, and maintaining accessibility while enhancing the authentication experience. Includes practical examples of CSP configuration, custom domain setup, and integrating external libraries via CDN for a fully branded sign-in experience.

recent_posts.title: Secure Authentication with a Push Notification in Your iOS Device
recent_posts.summary: Learn to implement native iOS authentication using Okta's DirectAuth SDK with push notification-based multi-factor authentication. The guide covers setting up an Okta developer account, configuring DirectAuth flows, building an AuthService with Swift, and creating SwiftUI views for sign-in, token management, and user profile display. The implementation eliminates browser redirects while maintaining OAuth 2.0/OIDC security standards, featuring phishing-resistant MFA through Okta Verify Push with biometric verification.

recent_posts.title: Customize Okta's sign in widget with design tokens and CSS
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to customize Okta's Gen3 Sign-In Widget to match your brand identity. The guide covers using design tokens for styling, manipulating DOM elements with the afterTransform method, implementing custom fonts and color palettes, adding custom HTML elements, and restructuring the page layout with CSS Flexbox. Includes practical examples of replacing default UI elements, organizing styles with CSS custom properties, and configuring Content Security Policies for external resources while maintaining accessibility standards.

recent_posts.title: Introducing the Okta MCP Server
recent_posts.summary: Okta has released an MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server that enables AI agents to securely interact with Okta's identity and access management APIs through natural language commands. The server supports user and group management, system logging, and authentication via Device Authorization Grant or Private Key JWT. It integrates with VS Code through GitHub Copilot, allowing developers to automate identity management tasks like user provisioning, group assignments, and security audits using conversational AI.

recent_posts.title: Build Secure Agent-to-App Connections with Cross App Access (XAA)
recent_posts.summary: Cross App Access (XAA) is a new protocol that enables secure agent-to-app and app-to-app communication with centralized enterprise IT control. The guide demonstrates implementing XAA using Okta as the identity provider, with practical examples of connecting an AI agent (Agent0) to a todo application (Todo0). It covers the complete setup process including OAuth 2.0 configuration, user management, and the Identity Assertion Authorization Grant flow that allows secure API calls between applications while maintaining enterprise oversight.
